assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and three KEY_AREA polygons are repository provisional rough geometry, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas and ratios require full recalculation after official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines and parcel controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Spatial and building moves are conceptual suggestions only; floor_area_ratio remains unknown.

assumptions.statement: Cleared building, ownership, facility, utility and heritage-control surveys are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Retain-renovate-demolish and infrastructure decisions use a method framework, not parcel conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Courses, events and governance mechanisms are an operating reference scheme.
assumptions.impact: Dates, budgets, organizers and public access require later authorization and co-design.
